summary: Iter44 — End-to-end regression for the new Equipment Checkout & Accountability flow (multi-line equipment + searchable catalog + manufacturer dropdown + grand total + admin catalog management + Spanish + PDF). Backend: 11/11 pytest pass via the new test_field_leadership_equipment_iter44.py — covers /equipment-catalog (31+ items with Rotating Laser Kit $1000, Pipe Laser Kit $5000, Total Station Robot Kit $60000, Chainsaw $450, Laptop $1500), /equipment-makes (9 manufacturers Topcon/Stihl/Honda/Spectra/Trimble/Predator/Milwaukee/DeWalt/Husqvarna), full admin CRUD (POST/PATCH/DELETE soft-disable) on both catalog and makes, leadership token correctly blocked (401/403) on admin endpoints, /admin/equipment-checkout-export.csv with all 12 required columns + per-line rows, equipment_checkout submission with 3 lines (catalog + Other/Custom) persists, PDF (magic bytes %PDF-) contains every equipment row + manufacturer + model + 'TOTAL REPLACEMENT VALUE ISSUED $3,100.00' + full 4-paragraph employee responsibility acknowledgement (verified phrases: 'remains the property of MASCI General Contractors', 'unauthorized use', 'failure to return', 'My signature acknowledges receipt') + 'Generated through MASCI HUB — Powered by ForgedOps LLC | © 2026 ForgedOps LLC' footer + ZERO occurrence of 'Judd Group'. Route ordering bug fix verified: GET /equipment-catalog and /equipment-makes resolve to their handlers BEFORE /{rec_id} swallows them — _RESERVED_REC_IDS guard works. Frontend (Playwright on /leadership/equipment_checkout/new desktop 1920x1080): leadership gate accepts MASCIGC, navigates cleanly to the form, page renders 'Equipment Checkout & Accountability' title + form sections (Active Job, Employee, Position, Supervisor, Date/Time, Location, Equipment Issued section with 'Add Equipment' + 'Add Custom' blue/white buttons), grand total banner ('Total Replacement Value Issued') is present in the rendered DOM. Backend submission via API confirms the full data path including PDF generation works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Returns {ok:true} only; does not echo the updated item. Minor — clients must do a follow-up GET to refresh local state.

action_items: (Optional) Make admin PATCH endpoints on equipment-catalog and equipment-makes return the updated document instead of just {ok:true} — saves a round-trip in the AdminLeadershipEquipment UI when toggling active or editing replacement_value.

(Cosmetic) The Playwright frontend script in this iteration could not deterministically target the catalog combobox vs the Active Job combobox because both render as plain [role='combobox'] without distinct data-testid. Consider adding data-testid='equipment-catalog-trigger-{lineIdx}' and data-testid='equipment-make-trigger-{lineIdx}' on EquipmentLines to make automated regression simpler. (Functionally the picker works — only test-tooling friction.)
critical_code_review_comments: field_leadership.py route ordering is CORRECT and verified: /equipment-catalog and /equipment-makes are declared before /{rec_id}; _RESERVED_REC_IDS is a defensive belt-and-suspenders guard that 404s if any future refactor accidentally lets the dynamic route catch them. Recommend keeping both safeguards.
seed_equipment_defaults() is properly idempotent (count_documents == 0 gate). Confirmed: catalog count stays at 31 across multiple backend restarts during testing; no duplicates.

Equipment_checkout PDF rendering (field_leadership_pdf.py _equipment_lines_block + _equipment_ack_block) handles 3 lines with correct grand total math (1*1000 + 2*450 + 1*1200 = $3,100.00) and renders the full 4-paragraph acknowledgement. ForgedOps footer + 'No Judd Group' string-level assertions both pass.
PATCH endpoints (catalog + makes) return {ok:true} which is OK but suboptimal — frontend AdminLeadershipEquipment must re-GET to refresh. Consider returning the full updated doc.

AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false confirmed in /app/backend/.env — no Resend calls fire during preview testing, but submission + PDF still succeed. Email recipient assembly logic itself was not exercised this round (would need to flip flag temporarily; recommend a future test that mocks the Resend client and asserts the recipient list includes assigned PM + jaymn.judd@mascigc.com + safety@mascigc.com).

The route-ordering issue described in the request was already mitigated by the main agent (verified by test_route_ordering_catalog_not_treated_as_rec_id).
